title: WP-Bot Intent Object
description: An intent object: what Track A (WhatsApp conversation service) sends to Track B (WordPress site/state service). This is one half of the only coupling point between the two services. Do not change without bumping contract_version and updating both tracks.

contract_version.description: Semantic version of this contract. Both services must send and accept the same value; a mismatch is a hard error (see README).

owner_id.description: Stable identifier of the business owner / site this intent applies to (e.g. the WhatsApp number or an internal account id).

action.description: What to do with the content.

content_type.description: What kind of content. job | announcement | business_info are the v1 MVP set. 'image' is introduced in v1.5 (see x-v1-mvp / x-introduced-in annotations below) — the schema validates it for forward compatibility, but Track B is NOT required to support it in the v1 MVP.

fields.description: Content payload. Shape depends on content_type; see $defs and the allOf rules below.

confidence.description: How confident Track A is that the parsed intent is correct (0.0 = no idea, 1.0 = certain). Used by Track B to decide when to ask for confirmation.

site_id.description: Optional target site for multi-site owners. When present, Track B resolves the site by this id instead of the default. Omit for single-site owners (backward compatible).

remote.description: True if the role is remote.

job_fields.description: Job posting fields. create requires title and description; update/delete may send a partial set (at least one field).

expires_at.description: Optional expiry, RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. '2026-07-04T23:59:59Z'. The pattern enforces the shape portably (the jsonschema lib no longer ships a date-time format checker).

announcement_fields.description: Announcement fields. create requires title and body; expires_at is always optional.

prices.description: Price list / menu prices, free text.

business_info_fields.description: Business info fields. ALL optional: partial updates are the intended use ('change my hours to 9-6' sends only hours). At least one field required.

slot.description: Where the image goes on the site.

media_url.description: Public URL of the image. Exactly one of media_url | media_base64 is required for create/update; neither is needed for delete (slot identifies the image).

media_base64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes. Exactly one of media_url | media_base64 is required for create/update.

image_fields.description: Image fields. v1.5 feature — NOT required for the v1 MVP. The schema validates it so both tracks can develop against the final shape.
